newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: FORECAST - Bank/Portugal not seen cutting rates now.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Bank/Portugal not seen cutting rates now.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal has room to cut its repo rate further but it is unlikely to take action on Wednesday when it announces terms for the new commercial bank reserve period, traders and analysts said.
Reuters polled six market sources for their views and all six ruled out any move on Wednesday.

The normally highly cautious central bank will wait for further signs of monetary easing elsewhere in Europe as well as for a clearer picture to emerge of the inflationary trend, the sources said. It will announce the new terms at 1315 GMT.
The Bank last cut the repo rate by 25 basis points to 7.25 percent on August 26. Its draining rate and the emergency lending rate have remained steady at 6.80 percent and 9.00 percent since April.
"I don't believe the Bank will touch rates now," said Jose Carlos Andre, chief dealer at Banco de Comercio & Industria.
Traders said that the Bank was likely to wait for inflation to renew its downward trend after the year-on-year rate rose to 3.8 percent in July from 3.6 percent in June.
August figures should be issued by September 13.
